title: Big Iron

[Intro]
[C]
[C]
To the town

[Verse 1]
[C]of Agua Fria rode a
[Am]stranger one fine day
Hardly
[C]spoke to folks around him, didn't have too much to say
[Am]No one
[F]dared to ask his business, no one
[C]dared to make a slip For the
stranger there among them had a
[Am]big iron on his hip
[F]Big iron on his
[C]hip
It was ear-

[Verse 2]
[C]ly in the morning when he
[Am]rode into the town
He came
[C]ridin' from the south side, slowly lookin' all around
[Am]He's an
[F]outlaw loose and running, came the
[C]whisper from each lip And he's
here to do some business with the
[Am]big iron on his hip
[F]Big iron on his
[C]hip
In this town

[Verse 3]
[C]there lived an outlaw by the
[Am]name of Texas Red
Many
[C]men had tried to take him and that many men were dead
[Am]He was
[F]vicious and a killer, though a
[C]youth of twenty-four And the
notches on his pistol numbered
[Am]one and nineteen more
[F]One and nineteen
[C]more
Now the stran-

[Verse 4]
[C]ger started talking, made it
[Am]plain to folks around
He was an
[C]Arizona Ranger, wouldn't be too long in town
[Am]He came
[F]here to take an outlaw back a-
[C]live or maybe dead And he
said it didn't matter, he was
[Am]after Texas Red
[F]After Texas
[C]Red
The morn-

[Verse 5]
[C]ing passed so quickly, it was
[Am]time for them to meet
It was
[C]twenty past eleven when they walked out in the street
[Am]Folks were
[F]watching from their windows, every-
[C]body held their breath They
knew this handsome ranger was a-
[Am]bout to meet his death Was a-
bout to meet his [F]death
[C]There was for-

[Verse 6]
[C]ty feet between them when they
[Am]stopped to make their play
And the
[C]swiftness of the ranger is still talked about today
[Am]Texas
[F]Red had not cleared leather when a
[C]bullet fairly ripped And the
ranger's aim was deadly with the
[Am]big iron on his hip
[F]The big iron on his
[C]hip

[Outro]
[F]Big iron, big
[C]iron When he
tried to match the ranger with the
[Am]big iron on his hip
[F]The big iron on his
[C]hip
